column3: | C827 | 扫描重建对deletion中与overwrite变短的镜像报不适用 | evidence: both cells are each pinned by one test case and judged to hold: `a_deletion_in_progress_leaves_only_that_object_out_and_the_scan_rebuild_holds` and `a_data_unit_left_beyond_the_size_by_a_shorter_overwrite_is_not_claimed_and_the_scan_rebuild_holds` in `crates/singlefs-harness/tests/scan_rebuild_agrees_with_the_walked_index.rs`. Neither cell reports not-applicable any more. With a deletion in progress only the object being deleted is left out of the comparison on both sides, and other objects are still compared (ruling `research/prompts/m3-multi-file-unlink-r1-main-verification.md` section 3, M5); a unit left beyond the size by a shorter overwrite is not claimed, by reading Z plus the write order (ruling `research/prompts/m4-trunc-r1-main-verification.md` K6). The two members `DeletionInProgressNotWrittenForTheScanRebuild` and `DataUnitBeyondTheSizeOfItsRecordCoveredByNoClause` of `ScanRebuildNotDecided` in `crates/singlefs-checker/src/rebuild.rs` have been deleted (`grep -rn` for the two names finds 0 places in `crates/`). The lineage and retirement record cells are judged for real by the reading the user fixed on 2026-10-14 (fork sheet `research/prompts/m4-batch2-code-r1-forks.md` line 1, option A); the shapes still undecidable are the two members `LineageRecordsFormNoParentChain` and `RetiredLeafContainerHasAVersionBornAfterItsDeath`, tracked in C615（扫盘重建对挂着时的回退没有输入） and C768（退役记录的扫描重建读侧没有消费者）. Origin: ruling `research/prompts/m4-batch2-code-r1-main-verification.md` section 2, S9 | 2026-10-19 |

column3: | C827 | 扫描重建对削除中与上書き变短的镜像报不适用 | 根拠：二つのセルはそれぞれ一つのテストケースで固定され、成立と判定された：`crates/singlefs-harness/tests/scan_rebuild_agrees_with_the_walked_index.rs` の `a_deletion_in_progress_leaves_only_that_object_out_and_the_scan_rebuild_holds` と `a_data_unit_left_beyond_the_size_by_a_shorter_overwrite_is_not_claimed_and_the_scan_rebuild_holds`。どちらのセルももう適用外とは報告しない。削除中は削除されているそのオブジェクトだけが両側とも比較から外れ、ほかのオブジェクトは比較される（判決 `research/prompts/m3-multi-file-unlink-r1-main-verification.md` 第三節 M5）；上書きが短くなって size の外に残ったユニットは、読み方 Z と書き込み順で認領しない（判決 `research/prompts/m4-trunc-r1-main-verification.md` K6）。`crates/singlefs-checker/src/rebuild.rs` の `ScanRebuildNotDecided` にあった二つのメンバー `DeletionInProgressNotWrittenForTheScanRebuild` と `DataUnitBeyondTheSizeOfItsRecordCoveredByNoClause` は削除済み（`crates/` で二つの名前を `grep -rn` して 0 件）。系譜レコードと退役レコードのセルは、ユーザーが 2026-10-14 に決めた読み方（分岐表 `research/prompts/m4-batch2-code-r1-forks.md` 第 1 行の甲）で実際に判定され、まだ判定できない形は `LineageRecordsFormNoParentChain` と `RetiredLeafContainerHasAVersionBornAfterItsDeath` の二つのメンバーで、C615（扫盘重建对挂着时的回退没有输入） と C768（退役记录的扫描重建读侧没有消费者） に紐づく。立項：判決 `research/prompts/m4-batch2-code-r1-main-verification.md` 第二節 S9 | 2026-10-19 |
